details.description: Evaluated Ambersorb XE-340 & XE-318. Pyridylized ion-exchange resin adsorbents, both fresh & aged. Evaluated NaBiO3 on Al2O3, SiO2, SiO2 w/sugar & MgO. Evaluated ascorbic acid on Carbon, Al2O3, tow. Evaluated Cu/Sn gel filter additives (preliminary expts).

Evaluated Ag/MoO4/Al2O3 (preliminary expts). Evaluated salcomine and salminine on carbon, Al2O3, SiO2-Al2O3, bauxite, tow. Evaluated salcomine on carbon, Al2O3, SiO2-Al2O3 (in progress). Evaluated poly-N,N'-1,2-phenylene (5,5'-methylenebis (salicylideneiminato)), cobalt (II) on Al2O3 & carbon.
Made 4 attempts at Al2O3 coating of supports (Al2O3 (pH 1) & 3.0 wt% on bauxite SRC). Evaluated two Pd/Cu catalysts based on the Lloyd & Rowe patents (on Al2O3 & SiO2-Al2O3).
